content:
Here's my 2-word name for this group:

**"Contradictory Humans"**

This captures the essence of people who simultaneously love and are harmed by the same thing (ice cream) and are drawn to something they can't quite grasp (mathematics) — a beautifully paradoxical but very **relatable** human condition! 😄
